source.note: Composed from the `tokenization-two-factor-authentication-code-sent` schema example for this event in Lithic's OpenAPI spec (https://github.com/lithic-com/lithic-openapi/blob/53e650d62efc04c85eccfa794629563ce865fe4d/lithic-openapi.yml), which the reference page renders.
